name: Core ModelPatcher patch API (reference)
plain: A reference entry for the hooks that other entries cite. Most hacks reach the model through these rather than editing it. Each call is cloned per node, so patches stay local to one MODEL wire unless a pack bypasses this.
math:
No formula. Hooks: model_options: sampler_cfg_function, sampler_post_cfg_function (list), sampler_pre_cfg_function (list), sampler_calc_cond_batch_function, model_function_wrapper, denoise_mask_function.
transformer_options['patches'][name] lists: attn1_patch, attn2_patch, attn1_output_patch, attn2_output_patch, input_block_patch, input_block_patch_after_skip, output_block_patch, emb_patch, forward_timestep_embed_patch, double_block, post_input, noise_refiner, middle_block_after_patch.
patches_replace: attn1, attn2, dit, by block key.
Other: add_object_patch (swap a named attribute), add_weight_wrapper, add_patches (weights), rope_options, optimized_attention_override.
Wrappers: OUTER_SAMPLE, PREPARE_SAMPLING, SAMPLER_SAMPLE, PREDICT_NOISE, CALC_COND_BATCH, APPLY_MODEL, DIFFUSION_MODEL.
Callbacks: ON_CLONE, ON_LOAD, ON_DETACH, ON_CLEANUP, ON_PRE_RUN, ON_PREPARE_STATE, ON_APPLY_HOOKS, ON_INJECT_MODEL, ON_EJECT_MODEL and more.

props.architectures: All; each model's forward decides which named patches it honours. UNet honours input/output_block; DiTs honour dit replace.
